body.message:
Hi,

I have now been without AC since this morning because your maintenance team confirmed there is an issue with the bathroom duct, and I was advised not to use the AC until it is repaired.

Later today, another technician came to inspect it again and said he would report the issue to his supervisor.

Please let me know what the plan is and how long this repair will take. In the meantime, I need a temporary solution, such as a fan or portable air cooler, because I cannot stay in the apartment without any cooling.

If the problem cannot be resolved today, please let me know what alternative you can provide, as I cannot continue staying in the apartment under these conditions. If necessary, I will need alternative accommodation until the apartment is ready to be occupied.
